name: buscool
description: Alexa skill for real-time bus arrival information (Kokusai Kogyo Bus / Navitime scraping)

scripts.deploy:zip: npm run build && rm -rf dist/node_modules dist/package.json dist/package-lock.json && cp package.json package-lock.json dist/ && cd dist && npm install --omit=dev --production && rm -f ../lambda-deploy.zip && cd .. && cd dist && zip -rq ../lambda-deploy.zip .
scripts.deploy:lambda: npm run deploy:zip && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name alexa-bus-kuru --zip-file fileb://lambda-deploy.zip --region ap-northeast-1

author: ambit1977
